name: Adv Audit Policies (SA)
help: Retrieves advanced security audit policies from local Group Policy
long_help: Reads and combines audit.csv files from the local Group Policy directory to display configured advanced audit policies. Shows audit subcategory settings including inclusion/exclusion criteria and success/failure auditing configuration.

arguments.name: isWow64
arguments.desc: Set to 1 if running from a WoW64 process (auto-detected by loader)
